about: Real-world JSON documents, pinned by upstream commit and sha256. Fetched into perf/e2e/corpus/ (gitignored) by `python3 perf/e2e/bench.py fetch`. Every document is a public benchmark document, a public dataset, or a public repository's own file; none is generated. `derived` entries are deterministic prefix slices of a fetched document (the first N records of a top-level array, re-serialized compactly with Python's json module, UTF-8 kept); `fetch` refuses to derive from a document holding any non-integer number, because re-serialization could change a number's text. `series` names a group of documents of ONE schema at several sizes; the report fits time ~ bytes^b over each group. `scenarios` limits an entry to those scenarios.
